description: The supported public Tsela API. Every /v1 operation implemented by the API has exactly one entry here; api/tests/test_public_contract_docs.py fails CI when the two drift apart.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-Request-ID
sharedResponseHeaders.description: Correlation ID for this request. Quote it when reporting a problem. You may send your own 8 to 128 character [A-Za-z0-9._-] value and it is echoed back.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-API-Version
sharedResponseHeaders.description: The API major version that served the request. Always v1.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-RateLimit-Limit
sharedResponseHeaders.description: Requests allowed per rolling hour for this key.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-RateLimit-Remaining
sharedResponseHeaders.description: Requests left in the current rolling hour, after this one.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-RateLimit-Reset
sharedResponseHeaders.description: Unix time (seconds) when the oldest request in the window expires and capacity is returned.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-Quota-Limit
sharedResponseHeaders.description: Requests allowed per calendar month (UTC) for this key.

sharedResponseHeaders.name: X-Quota-Remaining
sharedResponseHeaders.description: Requests left this month, after this one.

endpoints.title: List routes
endpoints.summary: Return published routes, newest first, with optional search and offset pagination.
endpoints.idempotency: Safe and idempotent. Repeating the request never changes state, so it is always safe to retry.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match against route name and description.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of routes to return.

response.description: A JSON array of routes. An empty array means no route matched.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Numeric route identifier used in the path of other endpoints.

fields.name: publicId
fields.description: Opaque identifier that never changes and is safe to store. Prefer it as your own foreign key.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short plain-text description, when one exists.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When the route was first published.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When any part of the route record last changed.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the route came from: community for a reviewed rider contribution.

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: unverified, field_verified (a person confirmed it on the road), or stale (the confirmation is more than 180 days old).

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.description: When the route was last field-verified, or null if it never was.

errors.meaning: X-API-Key is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.
errors.retry: Do not retry with the same key. Check the header, or rotate the key in the console.

errors.meaning: The key does not carry the routes:read scope.
errors.retry: Do not retry. Create a key with the required scope.

errors.meaning: A query parameter failed validation, for example limit=500.
errors.retry: Do not retry unchanged. Correct the parameter named in the detail array.

errors.meaning: The hourly limit, monthly quota, or invalid-credential limit was exceeded.
errors.retry: Wait for the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry. Spread requests out with backoff.
Retry with exponential backoff and jitter, up to three times. Quote X-Request-ID if it persists.

endpoints.pagination: Offset pagination. Request the next page with offset = offset + limit; a page shorter than limit is the last one. Order is newest first and stable for equal timestamps.
endpoints.caching: Responses are not cacheable by intermediaries (Cache-Control is not set to public). Cache on your side for at most a few minutes; route lists change rarely.
endpoints.timeout: Typical responses complete in well under a second. Use a client timeout of 10 seconds.
endpoints.freshness: Reflects the published route table at request time. Publishing a route makes it visible immediately.

endpoints.title: Get route geometry
endpoints.summary: Resolve one published route into its ordered, road-following geometry.
endpoints.idempotency: Safe and idempotent. Repeating the request never changes state, so it is always safe to retry.

parameters.name: route_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the route, as returned by List routes.

response.description: Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] pairs in route order.

example.warning: Road-aligned preview; field-recorded corridor verification is still required.

fields.name: routeId
fields.description: The route this geometry belongs to.

fields.name: coordinates
fields.description: Ordered [longitude, latitude] pairs along the road.

fields.name: distanceMeters
fields.description: Route length in metres, when the road router provided it.

fields.name: durationMinutes
fields.description: Estimated ride time in minutes, when available.

fields.name: geometrySource
fields.description: Where the line came from: osrm for road-following, stop_sequence for a straight fallback.

fields.name: isRoadAligned
fields.description: False means the line joins the stops directly and does not follow roads.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Always present today: it flags a fallback line or that the corridor has not been field-verified.

errors.meaning: X-API-Key is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.
errors.retry: Do not retry with the same key. Check the header, or rotate the key in the console.

errors.meaning: The key does not carry the routes:read scope.
errors.retry: Do not retry. Create a key with the required scope.

errors.meaning: No route exists with this identifier.
errors.retry: Do not retry. Confirm the identifier with List routes.

errors.meaning: route_id is not an integer, or the route has fewer than two stops.
errors.retry: Do not retry unchanged. Correct the identifier or choose another route.

errors.meaning: The hourly limit, monthly quota, or invalid-credential limit was exceeded.
errors.retry: Wait for the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry. Spread requests out with backoff.
Retry with exponential backoff and jitter, up to three times. Quote X-Request-ID if it persists.

endpoints.pagination: Not paginated. One route is returned per request.
endpoints.caching: Geometry for a route rarely changes. Cache it on your side for up to 24 hours, keyed by route_id.
endpoints.timeout: Road routing may take a few seconds on a cold route. Use a client timeout of 20 seconds. When the road router is unavailable the response falls back to a straight line with isRoadAligned set to false.
endpoints.freshness: Road geometry is cached server-side and can lag a stop edit by a short time. Treat isRoadAligned false, and any warning, as unverified.
